reason: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts (patch lines 227-237), when the sync endpoint is configured, the function awaits `fetch(CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, …)` and returns the raw Response without checking `response.ok` or validating the body. Callers then treat it as a token payload: Google reads `res?.data` and HubSpot types it as a `HubspotToken`.
